title: 第21章 寒梅立雪一句话吓退天人境第22章 被封印的亲兄弟
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
藤野一雄的脸色，瞬间难看到了极点。
梅映雪来了——这意味着眼前这个小子，这个亲口承认杀了他儿子的人，只能是南王世子，君临安之子，君傲！
梅映雪身形未动，人却已如瞬移般出现在君傲身侧。
她甚至没有看那两个扶桑超凡境一眼，只是周身那股清冷如寒梅的“势”微微一荡——
“噗！噗！”
影六和影七如遭无形重锤轰击，胸口齐齐塌陷，整个人倒飞出去，撞在岩壁上，鲜血狂喷，随即软软滑落，气息全无。
秒杀！
两名超凡境，连反应的机会都没有，便已毙命！
“梅映雪——！”藤野一雄目眦欲裂，浑身杀气冲天，双刀在鞘中嗡鸣震颤。
可他的脚，却死死钉在原地，不敢上前半步。
这个女人……
三日前，铁关城外三十里，她一剑斩了他们一位天人境的“影将”！
血染长空，尸骨无存！
他藤野一雄虽比那位强上一线，但也强得有限。对上梅映雪……他没有把握。
“藤野，”梅映雪抬眼，目光平静无波，“你想动手？”
声音清冷，却仿佛带着万载寒冰的凛冽。
藤野一雄胸口剧烈起伏，死死盯着梅映雪，又看向她身后被护得严严实实的君傲。
最终，他从牙缝里挤出一声野兽般的低吼，身形猛地向后暴退！
退至百丈外，他恨恨地瞪了矿场一眼，毫不犹豫地转身，化作一道黑虹，破空远遁！
竟是被一句话，生生吓退！

阿青和阿水松了口气，她们对自家小姐的实力有着绝对的信心，但亲眼见到天人境强者不战而逃，心中仍是震撼。
怀安却已惊得檀口微张，美眸圆睁。
一句话……吓跑了一个天人境？
这、这还是人吗？
梅映雪没有理会远遁的藤野一雄，她转过身，目光落在君傲脸上。
方才面对天人境犹带寒霜的俏脸，此刻彻底沉了下来，眸中冰意更盛。
“谁让你来南疆的？”
声音不大，却让君傲头皮一麻。
他缩了缩脖子，还没想好怎么回答，梅映雪冰冷的目光已扫向阿青和阿水。
“你们两个，也由着他胡闹？！”
“噗通！”
阿青和阿水毫不犹豫，单膝跪地，垂首请罪：“小姐恕罪！是世子……世子执意要来，还、还拿出了惊鸿令相逼，属下……不敢不从！”
君傲见状，连忙上前一步，挡在两女身前，脸上堆起讨好的笑：“娘子，娘子消消气！都是我的主意，跟她们没关系！你要罚就罚我！”
那语气，竟带上了几分撒娇的意味，与方才面对藤野一雄时的硬气判若两人。
梅映雪看着他这副模样，眼中冰意未消，却多了一丝无奈：“说说，你跑南疆来做什么？说不出个所以然来，看我怎么收拾你！”
content_en:
Fujino Kazuo's expression suddenly turned extremely ugly.
Mei Yingxue is here - this means that the boy in front of him, the person who personally admitted to killing his son, can only be the Crown Prince of Nan, Jun Lin'an's son, Jun Ao!
Mei Yingxue's figure did not move, but she appeared beside Jun Ao as if teleporting.
She didn't even look at the two Fusang transcendent realms, but the "power" that was as cold as cold plums around her body swayed slightly——
"Poof! Poof!"
Ying Six and Ying Seven felt as if they were bombarded by an invisible heavy hammer, their chests collapsed, and their whole bodies flew out and hit the rock wall. Blood spurted out, and then they fell softly, losing their breath.
Instant kill!
The two transcendent realms were killed before they even had a chance to react!
"Mei Yingxue——!" Fujino Kazuo's eyes were about to burst, his whole body was full of murderous aura, and his two swords buzzed and trembled in their sheaths.
But his feet were firmly fixed in place, and he did not dare to take a step forward.
This woman...
Three days ago, thirty miles outside Tieguan City, she killed one of their "Shadow Generals" who was in the Heavenly Realm with one sword!
The sky is stained with blood, and there are no bones left!
Although he, Kazuo Fujino, was better than that one, he was still only as strong as he could be. Facing Mei Yingxue...he was not sure.
"Fujiye," Mei Yingxue raised her eyes with a calm expression, "Do you want to take action?"
The voice was cold, but it seemed to be filled with the coldness of thousands of years of ice.
Fujino Kazuo's chest rose and fell violently, staring at Mei Yingxue, and then at Jun Ao who was being protected behind her.
Finally, he squeezed out a beast-like growl from between his teeth and violently retreated backwards!
Retreating a hundred feet away, he glared at the mine hatefully, turned around without hesitation, turned into a black rainbow, and escaped through the air!
He was actually scared away by just one word!
Ah Qing and Ah Shui breathed a sigh of relief. They had absolute confidence in their young lady's strength, but they were still shocked when they saw a strong man in the Heavenly Realm fleeing without a fight.
Huai'an was so shocked that Tan's mouth opened slightly and his beautiful eyes widened.
In one sentence...scared away a heavenly being?
Is this, is this still a human being?
Mei Yingxue ignored Fujino Kazuo who was fleeing far away. She turned around and her eyes fell on Jun Ao's face.
The pretty face that was still frosty when facing the Heavenly Realm just now, completely darkened at this moment, and the ice in her eyes became even stronger.
"Who asked you to come to Southern Xinjiang?"
The sound was not loud, but it made Jun Ao's scalp numb.
He shrank his neck, and before he could think of a reply, Mei Yingxue's cold eyes had already glanced at Ah Qing and Ah Shui.
"You two, let him do whatever you want?!"
"Plop!"
Ah Qing and Ah Shui did not hesitate, knelt down on one knee, and bowed their heads to apologize: "Miss, forgive me! It's the Crown Prince... The Crown Prince insisted on coming, and he also took out the Jinghong Order to force him, my subordinates... dare not disobey!"
Seeing this, Jun Ao quickly stepped forward and stood in front of the two women, with a flattering smile on his face: "Madam, madam, calm down! It's all my idea, it has nothing to do with them! If you want to punish me, punish me!"
That tone actually had a hint of coquettishness, which was completely different from the toughness he had shown when he faced Kazuo Fujino just now.
Mei Yingxue looked at his appearance, the ice in her eyes was still there, but there was a hint of helplessness: "Tell me, what are you doing here in southern Xinjiang? You can't explain it, let's see how I deal with you!"
